description: This file defines the hash_policy_traits template struct used internally in Abseil's container implementation to manage hash policies, key access, and memory usage for hash table slots.

classes.name: hash_policy_traits
classes.description: Template struct that defines hash policy behaviors for hash table implementations, including key access, memory usage, and iterator policies.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Returns a reference or value of the key, depending on the key type, with special handling for lvalue references and C++17 launder support.

methods.name: space_used
methods.description: Returns the amount of memory used by a slot, as defined by the policy.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies a functor to the element's key or value, facilitating flexible access patterns.

methods.name: mutable_key
methods.description: Returns a mutable reference to the key portion of a slot, used for node handle manipulation.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the value portion of an element, used in map-like containers.
